Cold Plunge Benefits

The best-supported cold plunge benefit is a modest reduction in muscle soreness after hard exercise. Cold water also triggers a large spike in noradrenaline. The catch: plunging right after strength training, done regularly, reduced gains in muscle size and strength in a 12-week trial.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.

By Cole Garrison, GarageRecoveryLab
